commands.review_summary:
The PR changes the Microsoft Teams plugin to parse preview-only quote-reply attachments, capture the quoted Teams message id, and fetch full quoted text for 1:1 DM quotes via Microsoft Graph.

PR surface: Source +68, Tests +155. Total +223 across 7 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main only reads Teams quote bodies from `itemprop="copy"`, so a preview-only Teams quote payload would not populate supplemental quote context. I did not run a live Teams repro.

target.title: fix(msteams): surface quoted message body in Teams quote replies
target.body:
## Problem When a user quote-replies to the bot's message in a Microsoft Teams 1:1 DM, the bot could not see the quoted message content — it only saw the user's new text. Root cause: Teams delivers the quoted text of a quote-reply inside `

…

` (a truncated snippet), but `extractMSTeamsQuoteInfo` only matched `

…

`. The match failed, `quoteInfo` came back `undefined`, and nothing was surfaced to the agent via `supplemental.quote`. ## Fix **1. Parser (primary):** `extractMSTeamsQuoteInfo` now matches `

` **or** `

` (prefers `copy`, falls back to `preview`), and captures the blockquote `itemid` as the quoted message id. Sender extraction (``) is unchanged. **2. Full text via Graph (enhancement):** the `preview` snippet is Teams-truncated, so when the quoted message id is known we fetch the complete text via the app-only endpoint `GET /chats/{chatId}/messages/{id}` (permitted with the `Chat.Read.All` application permission, unlike the delegated `/me/chats` listing) and use it as the quote body. Scoped to non-channel chats (DM + group) whose Graph chat id is a `19:` id — channel quote context is already covered by the thread-parent path. Wrapped in try/catch; **any failure degrades to the truncated preview from fix 1**, so message handling never breaks. ## Notes / limitations - For 1:1 DMs the Graph chat id is the synthesized `19:{aadObjectId}_{appId}@unq.gbl.spaces` (the fork already computes this for media). This has not been exhaustively verified as accepted by the message-fetch endpoint against every tenant; the graceful fallback ensures correctness regardless. A local `messageId → text` cache (extending `sent-message-cache.ts`) is a robust alternative if the synthesized id proves unreliable. - The delegated `resolveGraphChatId` path is untouched (still used elsewhere). ## Testing - `extensions/msteams/src/inbound.test.ts` — added tests for `preview`-only parsing, `copy`-preferred-over-`preview`, `itemid` capture, and a full real-payload case. - `extensions/msteams/src/graph-thread.test.ts` — added tests for the new `fetchChatMessageText` helper (HTML stripping + path, non-HTML trim, error → undefined, no-body → undefined). - Vitest (msteams): inbound + graph-thread suites pass (58 tests); message-handler suites pass (40 tests). - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` and `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` both pass with no errors. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
